axis: hopes left unmet → trust broken and the person deserted

members.tone: Puts the weight on not being there when relied on, covering both the proving undependable and the walking away, but stated as a lapse rather than a wrong.
The same desertion as *fail*, but framed as trust broken against the person left behind, which is why it is the heaviest word here.
The mildest of the three: hopes or expectations simply come up short, with none of *fail*'s claim that someone was depended on and abandoned.
